name: Air-Fryer Eggplant Slices with Tofu Dip
ingredients: 1 large eggplant (about 350 g), cut in 1 cm rounds
2 tbsp besan mixed with 3 tbsp water
½ tsp each paprika, garlic powder and oregano
Dip: 100 g silken tofu, 1 garlic clove, juice of ½ lemon, 1 tsp olive oil, salt, mint
steps: Salt the eggplant and rest for 10 minutes; pat dry.
Dip in the besan batter, then in the breadcrumbs mixed with the spices.
Preheat the air fryer to 190°C and spray the basket.
Cook for 12–15 minutes, turning halfway, until golden.
Blend the dip ingredients and serve with the eggplant.
note: Eggplant absorbs oil like a sponge when fried; the air fryer avoids that.
